claims.evidence: Witness photos show an Xbox-branded white console and an Xbox logo on the mesh/side panel, but do not show the exact model/version (One S vs other) or the storage size (1TB).
Photo 0 shows a black controller placed on top of the console; witness notes controller buttons and thumbsticks visible.
No photo evidence of the console dashboard/library or installed game list.

risks.risk: Wrong console model/storage capacity (e.g., not actually One S or not actually 1TB), which changes value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console model and storage info from Settings → System → Console info (or the label showing model/serial and storage).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case identification from photos (generic Xbox One-era console) and treat storage as unknown.

risks.risk: Controller may have stick drift, unresponsive buttons, or battery/charging issues.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing controller thumbsticks moving accurately in a calibration/test screen and buttons responding; also show charging/holding battery (or battery level).
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller condition unknown; assume potential faults until tested.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or unstable (fan/overheating, disc drive issues if applicable, or general performance problems).
risks.proof: A video clip of the console fully booting to the dashboard, playing/loading a game, and showing no overheating warnings (and disc drive test if it has one).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified/possibly needing service.

risks.risk: Missing essential accessories (power cable, HDMI cable) or incomplete bundle.
risks.proof: Photos showing all included items laid out (power brick/cable, HDMI cable, controller charging method/batteries if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console-only/unknown accessories until confirmed.

risks.risk: Account/console restrictions (account-banned, not reset properly, or locked to another account), reducing usability.
risks.proof: A photo/video showing the console is factory reset and signed out, then successfully signs in with a new account (or shows it’s ready for setup).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially restricted until proven reset/unlocked.

risks.risk: Physical condition issues not visible in the provided shots (scratches, dents, port wear, damaged mesh/vents).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of ports (HDMI, USB), power area, and corners/edges; plus a clear shot of the mesh/vents showing no damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic/vent condition since it’s not fully shown.

proof_requests: Clear photo of Settings → System → Console info showing model and storage size (or the label with model/storage).
Video of full boot to dashboard and confirmation that games are installed (open the Games/Apps library).
Video test of controller: thumbstick calibration/test screen and button responsiveness; show battery/charging status.
Photos of included accessories laid out (power cable/brick, HDMI cable, any other items).
Photo/video proving factory reset and sign-out status (setup screen or new account sign-in).
Close-up photos of all ports and the mesh/vent area for damage/wear.
response.reason: The witness confirms it’s an Xbox-branded console with a controller, but the key pricing drivers (exact model/version and storage, functional status, and bundle completeness) are not verifiable from the provided shots. Proof is needed to avoid overpaying for a potentially different or faulty unit.
